description:
Composition & Indication

Beclomethasone Inhaler 250mcg — 200 Doses contains Beclomethasone Dipropionate 250 mcg per actuation as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 200 Doses at the official 250mcg/dose strength. The standard indication is the management of asthma maintenance therapy, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Beclomethasone Inhaler 250mcg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
